records.title: Temporal Attack Pattern Detection in Multi-Agent AI Workflows: An Open Framework for Training Trace-Based Security Models
records.reason: The framework fine-tunes language models on agent security traces, including QLoRA; contribution is training/detection, not inference-serving efficiency.

records.title: Edge-Guided Multiscale Feature Fusion Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
records.reason: Tried the primary IEEE DOI/publisher page, which was inaccessible in the available reader; only abstract/metadata-level material was available, so primary methods/results could not be checked. The candidate is retained as borderline because its linked lineage makes the exact method relevant to resolve.

records.title: IH-Benchmark: A Conflict-Centered Benchmark for Instruction-Hierarchy Robustness in LLM Applications
records.reason: IH-Benchmark measures instruction-hierarchy robustness in LLM applications; it is a benchmark without compute/memory/latency optimization.

records.title: Harness TTS: Towards Context-Aware Expressive Speech Synthesis with Harness Layer
records.reason: Harness TTS wraps a speech engine and reports an LLM planner latency measurement, but no method lowers planner resources or serving cost.

records.title: Structured Feedback Improves Repair in an LLM Agent Loop
records.reason: VeriHarness caps agent repair at four calls and improves success at a fixed compute budget; no fewer calls/tokens or lower latency are reported.
